The '''Pii sun''' was an older [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] located in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]], along with the [[Star/Legends|sun]], was situated in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The sun was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by two [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]] and seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The latter included two [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] [[Stone/Legends|rock]] planets, two [[Forest/Legends|forested]] worlds, a barren planet, one [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], and a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] planet.

==Description==
The Pii sun was an older [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] situated in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]] of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]],<ref name="Greel" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Along with the rest of the Pii [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Star/Legends|sun]] was a seven-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] journey away from the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="Greel" /> and rested along the [[Old Corellian Run]] and the [[Trans Gulf Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="Atlas" />

The Pii sun, along with the rest of its system, was originally located on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. When that route changed its course<ref name="Atlas" /> at some time between around [[11,000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]<ref name="OldCorellianRunDate" /> and as a result no longer ran through the Pii system, the sun remained on the Old Corellian Run.<ref name="Atlas" />

The sun was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and two [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]]. The [[Pii system's first planet|first planet]] and [[Pii II]]&mdash;the second planet&mdash;were balls of [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] [[Stone/Legends|rock]]. The third and fourth planets, [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]] respectively, were [[Forest/Legends|forested]]. The sun's [[Pii system's fifth planet|fifth planet]] was barren, and the [[Pii system's sixth planet|sixth planet]] was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. The [[Pii system's seventh planet|seventh planet]] was [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]]. Two large but [[Mineral/Legends|mineral-poor]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields also circled the sun. The [[Pii system's first asteroid field|first]] orbited between Pii II and Pii III, while the second, wider [[Pii system's second asteroid field|asteroid field]] lay between the fifth and sixth planets, with a more erratic orbital pattern.<ref name="Greel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pii sun was first mentioned in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," an article written by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]] and featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine that was published by [[West End Games]] for their ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The issue released in [[May]] of [[1995]].<ref name="Greel" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pii system, and therefore its sun, in grid square R-16.<ref name="Atlas" />
